en_how: Two generated gameplay clips, each with sound generated alongside the picture, are cut into one highlight: a team-versus card opens, a score bar and round timer stay on top, kills slide into a feed and slam a big callout, a caster subtitle bar runs along the bottom, a team-colour diagonal wipe joins the clips, and a final freeze frame dims everything but a glowing ring around the player while the score flips to 3:2; in portrait the crop pans right to follow the explosion. Teams, players and the tournament are all fictional.
